description: Responsive Components and Performance Optimizations - Convert route imports to React.lazy with Suspense, add responsive component utilities (mobile-friendly modals, responsive tables as cards, collapsible filter panels, virtual scrolling hook), and memoized expensive computations.
steps: Refactor src/App.jsx: Convert all 16 page imports to use React.lazy(() => import('./pages/PageName')). Wrap the <Routes> in <Suspense fallback={<LoadingSpinner />}>. Create a simple LoadingSpinner component inline or as src/components/layout/LoadingSpinner.jsx (centered spinner with propela-purple color, animate-spin).

Create src/components/ui/ResponsiveModal.jsx: A modal wrapper that is centered dialog on desktop (max-w-lg, rounded-lg, with backdrop) but becomes full-screen on mobile (inset-0, no border-radius). Accept props: isOpen, onClose, title, children, size ('sm'|'md'|'lg'|'full'). Use fixed positioning, z-50, smooth fade-in animation. Close button is always 44px touch target.

Create src/components/ui/ResponsiveTable.jsx: On desktop (md+), renders a standard table. On mobile (<md), renders each row as a card (stacked key-value pairs). Accept props: columns (array of {key, label, render?}), data (array of row objects), onRowClick?. Use useMediaQuery to switch between table and card view.

Create src/components/ui/VirtualList.jsx: A virtualized list component for large datasets. Accept props: items (array), itemHeight (number, default 60), renderItem (function), containerHeight (string, default '500px'). Implement with simple scroll-based windowing: track scrollTop, compute visible range, render only visible items with spacers above/below. Use useCallback and useMemo for performance.

Create src/components/ui/CollapsibleFilter.jsx: A filter panel that is always visible on desktop but collapses into an expandable section on mobile. Props: title, children, defaultOpen (boolean). On mobile, shows a button 'Filters' with filter icon that toggles the panel open/closed with slide animation. On desktop, always renders children.

Create src/hooks/useMemoizedComputation.js: A hook that wraps useMemo with a stable dependency comparison using JSON.stringify for object deps. Useful for expensive computations on large datasets. Export as named export.

Add responsive chart container utility: Create src/components/ui/ResponsiveChartContainer.jsx that wraps Recharts ResponsiveContainer with aspect ratio that changes based on viewport (aspect={2} on desktop, aspect={1.2} on mobile). Accept children and optional aspectDesktop/aspectMobile props.
Ensure all new components use proper touch-friendly sizing: buttons min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px], form inputs min-h-[44px], tap targets have adequate spacing.
acceptance_criteria: All 16 page routes in src/App.jsx use React.lazy with dynamic imports
Suspense boundary wraps Routes with a loading spinner fallback
ResponsiveModal renders full-screen on mobile and centered dialog on desktop
ResponsiveTable switches between table and card view based on viewport width
VirtualList renders only visible items and handles scroll efficiently
CollapsibleFilter collapses on mobile, stays open on desktop
ResponsiveChartContainer adjusts aspect ratio based on viewport
All interactive elements have minimum 44px touch targets
npm run build succeeds with code-split chunks for each lazy-loaded page
